description: Defines the interface and supporting structures for an asynchronous IO broker, including configuration, subscriber management, and registration/unregistration of file descriptors.

classes.name: io_broker
classes.description: Interface for an asynchronous IO broker handling registration, deregistration, and event callbacks.

classes.name: io_broker::subscriber
classes.description: RAII handle for a registered file descriptor, managing its lifecycle within the IO broker.

methods.name: register_fd
methods.description: Registers a file descriptor with the IO broker, providing callbacks for data reception and error handling.

methods.name: unregister_fd
methods.description: Unregisters a file descriptor from the IO broker, signaling completion via a promise.
